renderBackend: Actual Lua Render + stomach study + connectivity additions evaluated by SVG/Cairo; not native GPU
limitations: Isolated layout only; production World/Vessels/Path and canonical map are not installed or modified.
Food exclusion is injected only in this test runtime; tissue lane 0 is forbidden inside food, declared vessel lanes may pass underneath its projection.
Successful cases confirm these local routes and gates only; arbitrary whole-stomach tissue connectivity and multi-unit crowd throughput are not proven.
Sealed-wall negatives use actual Path.clear directly; Commands may legitimately detour through a declared gate.
SVG/Cairo screenshots evaluate actual Lua drawing calls but do not prove native NanoVG antialiasing, frame time or mobile performance.
